_comment: Audio licence provenance. Background music is the most common cause of YouTube Content ID claims, which strip monetisation and can escalate to strikes. Every bed used in a published video must have a recorded, verifiable licence. The compliance gate reads this file.
_provenance: All active beds are synthesised from scratch by scripts/audio/generate-beds.sh using ffmpeg oscillators and noise generators only. The script is the licence: it is deterministic, so any run reproduces the same audio, and no third-party material is involved at any stage.
_archived: Six files of unverified origin were moved to public/sounds/_archive-unverified/. See DO-NOT-USE.md there before reinstating any of them.
_how_to_add: If you add third-party audio, set licence to one of legal.acceptable_audio_licences in compliance-policy.json, paste the exact source_url, and save the licence page as a PDF alongside this file. Never guess: a wrong entry is worse than an honest UNKNOWN.
